finding.statement: The current compiler/executor already accepts a bounded normal HP plus StanceValue request and commits HP then conditional toughness/Break in the selected reference model.

baseline.count_scope: Already measured canonical DamageByAttackProperty nodes, including nested operations: 3491 operations / 1362 records. Field counts overlap and are not compiler gains.
baseline.next_work: Cluster unsupported requests by actual field combinations. Do not reimplement basic HP+toughness composition or assume SPHitRatio is team skill points.
baseline.semantic_caution: Current ordering is a selected reference contract, not a native Golden trace; exact special-field formulas and callback ordering remain unresolved.

source_envelope.operation_id: Stable canonical identity; preserve original source path/hash, commit, container, nested path and raw source pointer when recovered
source_envelope.payload: Keep complete arguments and target expression; never replace absent fields with zero/default, decode ordinals by position, evaluate dynamic expressions, drop unknown fields, or conflate attacker/property provider/hit origin.
preserve: DynamicValue FixedValue/PostfixExpr with exact serialized constants, hashes and opcodes
EnumIndex/Value pairs and arrays in source order
operation-level OnAfterHit, overrides, equal-split, deferred-root-hit and last-kill flags
source_envelope.raw_numeric_lexemes: Canonical JSON pointer and source hash retain access to original numeric tokens. Evidence copies are parsed JSON for inspection; execution must preserve/evaluate source numeric lexemes with its proved arithmetic contract, never use this analysis process as the numeric runtime.

logical_layers: component descriptors including unresolved DamageValue role
request_model.ordering_warning: This list is an architecture decomposition, not a native total execution order. Survival preprocessing can precede HP; hooks/resource updates can interleave; preserve partial orders below.

components.value_input: optional DamageValue expression with UNRESOLVED_ROLE; can coexist with base and extra source
components.extra: optional ExtraFormulaType + ExtraDamagePercentage pair; independent source basis, native aggregation unknown
components.break: FormulaType=ByBreakDamage + BreakDamagePercentage observed as selected channel, not automatically an appended component
components.elation: FormulaType=ByElationDamage + ElationDamagePercentage observed as selected channel
components.toughness: StanceValue + StanceDamageType + relevant flags, separately retained

partition.hit_share: HitSplitRatio expression; authored requests are already separate hits in witnessed sequences
partition.resource_share: SPHitRatio expression; resource-accounting reconstruction, not HP or team-BP multiplier
partition.target_share: EqualSplitInTargets at operation level is a separate cardinality dependency

request_model.metadata: AttackType, DamageTag, CustomName, HitSource, provenance and callback descriptors; metadata may select arithmetic-changing hooks without becoming numeric factors

classification.statement: Hit-related SP/energy accounting factor, distinct from team BP economy, HP ratio, stance and hit partition. Exact recipient, base, formula, scaling/once-per-skill rule and mutation time remain unresolved. The letters SP alone do not prove this classification.
evidence: AttackData F96943; RtAttackData F101424; ModifyDamageData F99877
MonsterSkillRow F68271 SPHitBase; pinned sample value 10

facts: 2569 request occurrences; Black Swan primary hit has SPHitRatio=1, adjacent hit omits it while retaining damage and stance. Absence default is unknown.
Huohuo four requests use HitSplitRatio 0.2/0.2/0.2/0.4 but SPHitRatio=1 on each. This disproves aliasing the two ratios; their multiplication or separate timing is still unproved.
SPHitRatio also exists on HealHP; a universal HP-damage/toughness/super-break interpretation is unsupported.
Huanlong OnBeforeHit explicitly supplies ModifyDamageData.AttackData_SPHitRatio=1; dynamic modification belongs to frozen Domain 2 boundary.
sp_hit_ratio.negative_team_sp: Do not emit team skill-point gain/loss from SPHitRatio. Native AvatarSkillRow and SkillCharacterComponent declare separate SP and BP families; a ratio in HealHP and repeated monster/avatar hit requests is not a signed team-economy operation. Energy reading is a reconstruction, not a recovered CurrentSP write join.

candidate_consumer.fact: M507312 receives request B and on one branch forwards B+0x1B0 to ModifyProperty with property operand 12 and operation operand 2.
candidate_consumer.unknown: No named SPHitRatio -> +0x1B0 writer or property/operation enum-value proof recovered. Do not label this an exact SP write yet.
